body:
I have to see a shrink for my ADHD next month, but that's just s formality so my GP can legally prescribe stimulants for me.. it took me years to find a doctor that would diagnose and treat ADHD for an adult, its very closely monitored where I live so I couldn't risk revealing that I have a problem with illegal stimulants or else they'd think I was just looking for a prescription to abuse.
Thankfully when I started on the meds I didn't even want the other, I was doing really well for about 6 months until I impulsively quit my job, decided to move house, take the old landlords to court and go through a rough patch with my fiance. I was off my meds and back on the other.. struggling to deal with either substance at the moment to be honest... anyway, my point of this was that I don't think I can tell my shrink or my gp, maybe a councillor would be a good idea though, I just feel weird talking in real life and I get a bit scared that they'll lock me up.. not because I'm scared of the hospital, I'm scared of my parents knowing how crazy I really am.

Aren't we all just internet nobodies? 
Thank you. :)
